title: Patient Refill Requests for PAP Supplies — PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Rule.** A refill request in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program records the patient's own request for PAP supply items, and its item list is worked out from the enrollment's records. For a refill request the patient places on a phone call, and only for such a request, a refill is confirmed on the patient's own answer in the call, asking for the items that are due and reporting their supply as nearly exhausted, and the items it records are the request's item list; every other refill confirmation remains under the program's general refill confirmation rule.

**Channel.** A request is placed on a phone call only on a schedule whose accepted channels include phone calls; on a schedule that accepts no phone call, such as the Self-Pay Supply Subscription, no request is recorded on the call.

## When the item list is fixed

The item list is fixed only after every earlier refill confirmation naming disposable filters whose last shipping day falls on the day of the request stands answered by a coverage-billed disposable-filter line shipped on or after its contact date.

No item list is fixed until the newest coverage-billed line that shipped a cushion item not fitting the recorded mask style stands answered by a no-charge reship of the fitting cushion item.

The item list is fixed only after the enrollment's continued-use date is no older than the credited date of the proof of continued use that governs on the device record.

## Placing the request — `confirm_refill_request_b3535d21`

**Capability.** With `confirm_refill_request_b3535d21` the patient, on the phone call, places a refill request for PAP supplies on their own supply enrollment. One call records one refill confirmation dated today, received through the phone channel, naming the supply items the patient asks to receive and the supply status the patient reports. Once recorded, the request is visible on the enrollment's refill-contact history.

**How it is invoked.** This is the patient's own tool: the agent unlocks `confirm_refill_request_b3535d21` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `resupply_holding_id` | the reference number of the patient's PAP supply enrollment, read from the enrollment lookup before the call | identifier text |
| `items_requested` | the supply items the request names | HCPCS codes separated by commas in ascending order, no spaces, each code written in full as one capital letter followed by four digits and named once; an empty string is not accepted as a request |
| `supply_status_confirmed` | what the patient reports about the supply on hand of the items named | `nearly_exhausted` (the supply of those items is used up or about to run out) or `not_exhausted` (those items still have useful supply left) |

**Return.** A receipt in which `status` is `recorded` when the request was written; `resupply_contact_id` is the reference number of the new refill confirmation; `contact_date` is today's date (YYYY-MM-DD); `contact_channel` is `phone_call`; `items_requested` echoes the HCPCS codes recorded (comma separated, ascending); `supply_status_confirmed` echoes the reported supply status.

## Basis Q&A

**Whose words confirm a refill requested on a phone call?** The patient's own answer in the call, asking for the items that are due and reporting their supply as nearly exhausted.

**A patient on the Self-Pay Supply Subscription calls to ask for a refill. Is a request recorded on the call?** No. That schedule accepts no phone call, so no request is recorded on the call.

**Which items does the request record?** The request's item list, worked out from the enrollment's records.
